title: Chamfered spacer block
prompt: Spacer block, 30 × 30 × 12 mm, centred on the origin on Z = 0, with an M6 clearance hole (normal fit) straight down the middle and a 1 mm chamfer on every edge of the top and bottom faces (the vertical edges stay sharp). Make the chamfers a chamfer feature.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Eight 1 mm chamfers: the four top and four bottom edges
An Ø6.6 hole on the axis

notes: 8 edge chamfers of 0.5 mm² over 30 mm, less the mitred corner overlaps, = 117.33; the M6 normal clearance hole Ø6.6 removes π·3.3²·12 = 410.54. Construction: chamfers reads the chamfer features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only that test (candidate --intersected-chamfers).
